name: linger
description: Linger — a realtime oral-history companion for families

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn linger_api.main:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @linger/protocol && npm run build --workspace @linger/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @linger/protocol && npm run test --workspace @linger/web && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests -c apps/api/pyproject.toml
scripts.test:api: uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests -c apps/api/pyproject.toml
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @linger/web && uv run --project apps/api ruff check --config apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @linger/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @linger/web && uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/linger_api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
